title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Judges 13: the birth of Samson, with the angel's visits to Manoah and his wife, the Nazirite promise and the flame on the altar.

questions.text: Into whose hand did Yahweh deliver Israel for forty years?
questions.explanation: Israel again did evil in Yahweh's sight, and Yahweh delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

questions.text: Manoah, of the family of the Danites, was a man of which town?
questions.explanation: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah.

questions.text: What did the angel first tell Manoah's wife to beware of?
questions.explanation: The angel said, "Drink no wine nor strong drink, and don't eat any unclean thing."

answers.text: Wine, strong drink and anything unclean
Touching the body of a dead man
Leaving her house for forty days

questions.text: What would never come on the child's head?
questions.explanation: The angel said, "No razor shall come on his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb."

questions.text: How did Manoah's wife describe the face of the man of God?
questions.explanation: She said his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome.

answers.text: Shining as bright as the sun
Like the face of the angel of God
Like the face of an old prophet

questions.text: Where was Manoah's wife when the angel of God came to her a second time?
questions.explanation: The angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field, but Manoah her husband wasn't with her.

questions.text: What did the angel say Manoah must do if he prepared a burnt offering?
questions.explanation: The angel said, "If you will prepare a burnt offering, you must offer it to Yahweh."

answers.text: Bring it to the priest at Shiloh

questions.text: How did the angel answer when Manoah asked his name?
questions.explanation: The angel said, "Why do you ask about my name, since it is incomprehensible?"

answers.text: He said his name was Gabriel
He told him to ask the priests at Shiloh
He said he would tell him after the birth
He asked why, since his name is incomprehensible

questions.text: What did Yahweh's angel do when the flame went up from the altar?
questions.explanation: When the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, Yahweh's angel ascended in the flame of the altar.

answers.text: He touched the rock with his staff
He ascended in the flame of the altar
He blessed Manoah and walked away

questions.text: Where did Yahweh's Spirit begin to move Samson?
questions.explanation: The woman bore a son and named him Samson, and Yahweh's Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
